slots.name: victim age
slots.sentence: "He is paralyzed from the chest down," prosecutors said in the complaint, adding that the boy is in stable but serious condition at Lurie Children's Hospital in Chicago.

slots.name: suspect age
slots.sentence: The suspect, 19-year-old Muhammad Sayadul Boshar, was arrested and charged with one count of attempted murder, one count of aggravated battery and four counts of aggravated discharge of a firearm at an occupied vehicle, police said.

slots.name: target age
slots.sentence: The man told police he and Boshar began aggressively yelling at him and brandished a handgun, according to the court records.

slots.name: shooting distance
slots.sentence: Just before 3 p.m. on Friday, the man told police he was a passenger in a car with two friends, including one who had his 3-year-old son in the rear passenger seat, when they drove by Boshar's West Ridge home and saw him standing outside, according to the court documents.

slots.name: paralysis status
slots.sentence: A 14-year-old boy described by police as an innocent bystander was paralyzed from the chest down after being struck on a Chicago street by a stray bullet allegedly fired by a man who missed his intended target, according to court records.

slots.name: victim distance from shooting
slots.sentence: The boy who was paralyzed was about a block and a half from where the shooting erupted and was unlocking a Lime scooter when the stray bullet hit him, according to the court documents.
